whoItsFor: Developers and designers who use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) and want better UI design output, such as distinct design directions, side-by-side comparisons, and refinement against real screenshots.
useCases: Explore several distinct design directions for a website, app, or dashboard and compare them side by side
Refine a chosen design against desktop and mobile screenshots with an agent
Recreate an existing page from a screenshot and add a mobile layout
